body:
Adds `research/reject-surrogates`: reject-option case of the polyhedral-embedding view of surrogate losses (Frongillo–Waggoner) applied to a verifier that can accept, reject, or escalate to refereed re-execution.

- Generalised-hinge conditional risk is minimised exactly at the kink encoding the Bayes action (0 mismatches).
- Regret transfers linearly with constant exactly 2d (grid-verified, tight case derived).
- Logistic transfer ratio degrades as 2d(1-d)/δ.
- Negative result: in scalar SGD, logistic-plus-thresholds still beats the polyhedral learner.
- 6 tests, stdlib only; README and portfolio page updated.
